in_sanskrit.name: Niket
in_sanskrit.meaning: to bring near, to invite, to call, to summon, to attract, to entice
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: derived from the Sanskrit root 'Ni-keta' (नि-केत), where 'Ni' (नि) means 'near' or 'towards' and 'keta' (केत) means 'summon, call, invite, entice'

in_marathi.name: Niket
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niket हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Niket is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niketa' which means 'victory', 'triumph' or 'conqueror'. This name is often used in Hindu mythology for gods and warriors who have achieved great victories.
